verdict.rationale: three.js ships a first-party editor at threejs.org/editor, and TransformControls is listed among its controls. Beyond that, the evidence is only a bare link, and the documented workflow is code-first: scenes, cameras and meshes are built in JavaScript. missing for 10: documented viewport/inspector features, prefab or reusable scene-composition support, evidence that the editor is the primary level-building workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical artist, a full visual editor — viewport, inspector, prefabs/scene composition — is the primary way to build levels
